scheduled_jobs_finished_check.name: scheduled_jobs_finished_check
scheduled_jobs_finished_check.value: "scheduled_jobs"."last_finished_at" IS NULL OR ("scheduled_jobs"."last_started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "scheduled_jobs"."last_finished_at" >= "scheduled_jobs"."last_started_at")

scheduled_jobs_tick_check.name: scheduled_jobs_tick_check
scheduled_jobs_tick_check.value: "scheduled_jobs"."last_tick" IS NULL OR "scheduled_jobs"."last_finished_at" IS NOT NULL

audit_log_before_or_after_check.name: audit_log_before_or_after_check
audit_log_before_or_after_check.value: "audit_log"."before" IS NOT NULL OR "audit_log"."after" IS NOT NULL

settings_price_hint_percent_check.name: settings_price_hint_percent_check
settings_price_hint_percent_check.value: key <> 'price_hint_percent' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value)::numeric <> trunc((value)::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value)::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 END)

settings_overspend_guard_percent_check.name: settings_overspend_guard_percent_check
settings_overspend_guard_percent_check.value: key <> 'overspend_guard_percent' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) = 'string' THEN value = '"off"'::jsonb ELSE CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value)::numeric <> trunc((value)::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value)::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1000 END END)

settings_reminder_hours_check.name: settings_reminder_hours_check
settings_reminder_hours_check.value: key <> 'reminder_hours' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value)::numeric <> trunc((value)::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value)::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 720 END)

settings_escalation_hours_check.name: settings_escalation_hours_check
settings_escalation_hours_check.value: key <> 'escalation_hours' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value)::numeric <> trunc((value)::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value)::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 720 END)

settings_school_name_check.name: settings_school_name_check
settings_school_name_check.value: key <> 'school_name' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' THEN false WHEN (value #>> '{}') ~ '^[[:space:]]|[[:space:]]$' THEN false ELSE char_length(value #>> '{}') BETWEEN 1 AND 120 END)

settings_school_year_start_check.name: settings_school_year_start_check
settings_school_year_start_check.value: key <> 'school_year_start' OR (CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' THEN false WHEN value - 'month' - 'day' <> '{}'::jsonb THEN false WHEN NOT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value -> 'month') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value -> 'month')::numeric <> trunc((value -> 'month')::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value -> 'month')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 12 END THEN false WHEN NOT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value -> 'day') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN false WHEN (value -> 'day')::numeric <> trunc((value -> 'day')::numeric) THEN false ELSE (value -> 'day')::numeric BETWEEN 1 AND 31 END THEN false ELSE (value ->> 'day')::int <= CASE (value ->> 'month')::int WHEN 2 THEN 28 WHEN 4 THEN 30 WHEN 6 THEN 30 WHEN 9 THEN 30 WHEN 11 THEN 30 ELSE 31 END END)
